$schema: L1 dispatch benchmark — measured skill-selection accuracy over auto-extracted cases. Written by .claude/workflows/bench-dispatch.js (Persist phase only). Declared policy lives in engine.json; this file is MEASURED state, which is why health.sh checks only that it is current, never its values.
metric: top1_hard — top-1 dispatch accuracy on non-trivial cases
definition: Given the exact frontmatter listing (skill + description + when_to_use) for every file-backed skill and one natural-language prompt, the fraction of cases where the rank-1 answer equals the extracted label — excluding cases whose prompt is literally the skill's own name, and after adversarial adjudication of every miss.
source: .claude/workflows/bench-dispatch.js + .claude/scripts/extract-dispatch-cases.mjs (deterministic extraction; grading is pure string comparison, zero LLM)
last_updated_by: baseline reset — 20 skills gained when_to_use, awaiting re-run
known_biases: Answer-key leakage: graders must read ONLY the --redacted view. The full case set, any SKILL.md (trigger phrases sit verbatim beside the skill name), and vocabulary.json all reveal labels. Enforced by redaction + an emit-time assertion, and verified after every run by audit-bench-run.mjs, which fails the run on any forbidden read.

Proxy: the harness shows the skill listing only. It does NOT carry .claude/CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, ~25 MCP servers' tool listings, or conversation history. Under-estimates the claude_md_routed skills (CLAUDE.md's Behavior section routes them directly, so their frontmatter was never the binding constraint); over-estimates higgs/issue/deploy whose real competitor is an MCP tool the harness cannot show; under-estimates ship/watch/check which are context-dependent and here always cold-start.

Batching: a model shown 40 prompts at once knows it is a benchmark and spreads answers to avoid repeating itself — an anti-correlation the live loop lacks. Mitigated by deterministic interleaving, not solved.
Blind spot: 3 vocabulary spells route to a Claude Code built-in that has no file on disk, so the harness cannot show the model its text and those dispatch decisions cannot be scored.

targets.note: establish the number, change no skill except the proven deploy defect
top1_hard; destructive_fp must be 0 at every checkpoint regardless of accuracy

proxy_fidelity.note: run the real (prompt → skill) pairs harvested from ~/.claude/projects/ through the identical harness; n climbs for free every session

judge_calibration.note: L3 only — not applicable to L1, whose grading is exact string comparison

weekly_history.note: VOID — see invalidated_reason. No conclusion may be drawn from this row.
weekly_history.invalidated_reason: CONTAMINATED — not a measurement. The dispatch agents were told to read .claude/evals/cases/dispatch.json for prompts, and that file carries `label` (plus `source`, which announces a none-case, and `tags`). They read the answer key. Proven post-hoc by audit-bench-run.mjs: 46 forbidden reads across 11 blind agents. Fixed by a --redacted grader view (id + prompt + listing only, with an emit-time assertion that no label/source/tags/split survive) and an explicit prohibition on reading any other source. Retained rather than deleted so the failure stays visible.

weekly_history.note: First VALID run (the earlier 0.9942 was contaminated — see the invalid row). Redaction held, audit clean. One real miss in 402 cases after adjudication: banner → higgs, should be carousel. The ceiling, not the score, is the result.

BASELINE RESET, not a scored run. higgs's trigger list dropped 'og image' and 'social card' (vocabulary.json routes both Portrait Gallery spells to /carousel), and its opening prose dropped 'banner, og image, social card' for the same reason. 'hero image' and 'mockup' were KEPT — the proposal originally named them too, but the Portrait Gallery authority routes both to /higgs, so removing them would have been wrong. Scores before and after this line are not comparable. Next run re-establishes the number.
Not degraded — clean run, 400 cases scored, 1 adjudicated away, 0 unadjudicated.

BASELINE RESET. 20 skills that had no when_to_use at all gained one, so they are now reachable by prose rather than only by exact name. Corpus 401 -> 477 cases; listing 26212 -> 31428 chars (cap raised 26500 -> 32000, reasoning in engine.json eval.listing_cap_history). Also: from-shadcn now routes to /shadcn. The next run tests whether +5.2k chars of listing degraded dispatch — the question the cap was only ever a proxy for.

stratified.$comment: top1 by difficulty stratum, clean run 2026-08-06. The ceiling is the finding: after adjudication exactly ONE real miss remains in 402 cases, so this metric has almost no power to detect improvement. Its job is regression detection, not tuning.

positive_trivial.note: prompt IS the skill name — measures string equality

positive_lexical.note: prompt CONTAINS the skill name — the answer is in the question

positive_lexical_free.note: no lexical overlap — the honest difficulty floor

findings.detail: higgs's when_to_use declares itself 'the TEXT-FREE lane: og images, infographics, testimonials, split comparisons and anything carrying copy render on /carousel's template lane instead' — and its own Triggers on: list then claims 'og image', 'social card', 'hero image', 'mockup', 'moodboard'. It cedes the territory and claims it in the same field. Symptom: the single real miss in 402 cases is 'banner' → answered higgs, labelled carousel (adjudicator confirmed the label). The extractor independently flags 'og image' as a prompt-collision between the two.
findings.applied: 2026-08-06 — removed 'og image' + 'social card' from the trigger list and 'banner, og image, social card' from the opening prose. Kept 'hero image' and 'mockup': vocabulary.json routes those spells to /higgs, so the original proposal over-reached on two of its four phrases.
findings.verification: Confirmed by run wf_08972dd0-f09 (audit CLEAN). The prediction was stated before the run and held: higgs precision 0.9655 → 1.0, carousel recall 0.9167 → 1.0, top_confusions now empty.

findings.detail: Two none-cases were adjudicated away as extraction artifacts, not model errors: 'from shadcn' (portkey spell with no skill-type order entry, though a shadcn skill exists) and 'drift' (spell routes to familiar:learn while its own effect reads 'Alias of the learn/health surface'). Same class as the six spell-skill collisions generate-vocab.mjs now warns on — vocabulary.json's order chains are stale where a skill has since been created.

L1 now scores 1.0 on every metric across 400 cases — top1, top1_lexical_free (n=197), top3, mrr, macro_f1 and holdout, with fp_rate 0 and zero confusions. The metric has NO remaining headroom: it cannot detect improvement, and the /bench --tune lane has no target at L1. Its only remaining job is regression detection — if a future edit breaks routing, this catches it. Restoring discriminating power needs adversarial cases authored in the measured confusion zones (plan/tasks 0.683, approve/publish 0.587, build/check 0.485) by some hand other than the one that wrote the descriptions. The current cases were written as examples of what SHOULD route somewhere, so they are the easy cases by construction.
findings.implication: Do not read 1.0 as the engine being perfect. Read it as this test no longer being able to tell us anything new.

findings.detail: The Portkeys spell `from shadcn` was adjudicated away as a labelling artifact in BOTH independent runs: its order chain lists a familiar + portal but no {type:skill} entry, so the extractor derives label=none — while a `shadcn` skill exists and is the defensible answer. Same class as the six spell-skill collisions generate-vocab.mjs warns on. The fix belongs in vocabulary.json, not in the harness.
findings.fix: add {type:"skill", name:"/shadcn"} to the `from shadcn` spell order chain
